info.title: Freya Bank voice statement services
info.description: Seven POST services, JSON in/out, UTF-8. Request {data, call}; answer {data, result}. Dates dd.MM.yyyy, amounts JSON numbers. Get a bearer token first (client-credentials at tokenUrl; the test environment does not check it, send it anyway). Service names contain dots.

post.summary: The customer's cards the assistant may talk about
post.description: Start here: the phone menu hands over the customer number, there is no customer search. Only active cards (status 'A') come back; isMainCard=false for a card that is not the customer's own main card, still listed. Two cards can share productName AND cardNumberLast4 - do not assume the last four are unique. cardNumber is masked in test (first 6, last 4); send it unchanged to the other services.

post.summary: Statement and due dates, debt per currency for one card
post.description: Send cardNumber exactly as cards.list returned it. The answer's own cardNumber is masked differently (first 4 + last 4): do not match it against the list, use cardNumberLast4 or keep the number you sent. Dates dd.MM.yyyy, amounts are numbers (dot decimal, never rounded). debtTL/debtUSD/debtEUR/debtGBP: a block can be missing.

post.summary: The card's current statement week and day, joint statement info
post.description: statementWeek 1-4 and statementDay are numbers here. relationType '' = own statement; 'M' = main card of a pair sharing one statement, 'C' = the linked card; relatedCardNumber/relatedCardProductName name the other card. Changing the week on either card moves both. No field says whether the customer may still change the week.

post.summary: Change the card's statement week (side effect)
post.description: Call only after the caller agreed to the dates from statement.week.decide. statementDay is required (send the current day). NOTE: statementWeek and statementDay come back as STRINGS here; ignore statementDay in the answer and tell the caller the dates from decide. Success = exitState 'OK' and responseCode 0. No automatic retry.

post.summary: The registered e-mail / phone of the customer
post.description: intAddressInfoType: 'E' e-mail, 'P' phone, 'B' both (empty = 400). The registered e-mail is ibanEmail (the iban prefix is historical); ttsEmail is the same prepared for reading aloud. No registered e-mail = communicationType 'Phone' and/or empty ibanEmail: check the field, not only the type.
